kind: matched local technical/design comparison, no human A/B
candidateA: current whole-room fit, repaired long-name bounds, identical projection instrumentation
candidateB: fixed orientation orthographic close play, bounded self-follow/deadzone, accessible Overview/Recenter, stable edit overview
sameInput: actual independent local identities, initial server spawn/room geometry, same names/chat; native forms for all actions
tasks: Can chat and fresh attributed text

mechanicalAcceptance.prominence: provisional upright head-to-foot projected CSS height96-160 desktop and56-88 phone; explicit rationale required for viewport constraints below this range
mechanicalAcceptance.room: projected room footprint >=80% usable width OR >=70% usable height; cropping allowed in play
mechanicalAcceptance.self: upright head/foot visible in a HUD-free play rectangle while moving and after resize; no invented relocation
mechanicalAcceptance.idle: after settling, camera displacement <1 CSS pixel over5 seconds; no idle zoom/yaw
mechanicalAcceptance.labels: painted glyphs bounded, attributed labels do not overlap HUD/takeover/camera controls; offscreen people do not float in screen-edge speech
mechanicalAcceptance.invariants: same movement speed/collision/routes, controller/IME guards, privacy clearing, monotonic four-second max3 bubbles, no history replay
mechanicalAcceptance.pick: visible actual projected door/seat/furniture target hits same authoritative target; overview movement clearly returns to play

stopping: stop after red/green, matched native projection/PNG measurements and fresh reviewer findings reconciled; failed criteria require refinement or parent decision
qualifications: SwiftShader localhost is not physical-phone/GPU/Fly measurement
Concurrent UI changes must be captured as confounders
